card.name: Next dose number in a dose list
card.fires_on: The space or word "to" just before a second dose number (like 50 or 150) in dose ranges, titration schedules and dose tables. It fires where a new milligram amount is about to begin.

modes.label: Range after "to"
modes.description: The gap or "to" between two ends of a dose range, right before the upper number.
modes.example: Diphenhydramine 25 mg to<< >>50 mg (or equivalent) one

modes.label: Step in a titration schedule
modes.description: The space before the next, larger dose in a week-by-week or day-by-day schedule.

card.writes: It likely promotes the start of a number, mostly digits and name pieces, so a new dose figure comes next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a new dose amount is about to be written, such as the upper end of a range or the next step up.
